title: Vehicle and scene assets
current_gap: P450 visual and Hex/native evidence cover bounded slices; a complete vehicle/scene catalog, selection/import workflow and ClassID-to-asset binding are not accepted.

atoms.name: vehicle_geometry
atoms.required: Per-vehicle geometry/source/license/hash, scale/frame and real readback

atoms.name: scene_selection
atoms.required: Versioned selectable scenes with source/hash/origin/scale and errors

atoms.name: asset_import
atoms.required: Owned import/validate/save/reload workflow and license manifest

atoms.name: class_id_mapping
atoms.required: Explicit ClassID namespace-to-asset binding and mismatch rejection

atoms.name: vehicle_scene_physics_identity
atoms.required: Common identity without mixing visual and physics scopes

scope_rule: visual assets mirror authoritative physics unless a manifest explicitly declares otherwise
class_id_rule: ClassID=-1 is not an asset binding

files: UE/asset source reserved after resource decision

followups.blocked_by: Explicit ClassID namespace and asset manifest
